label: conj:cp-violation-spectral-form
title: $\delta_{\mathrm{CP}}$ as imaginary part of the alternating-block character
html:
Conjecture (spectral form of \delta_{\mathrm{CP}}). Let A = H_n(R_\mathbb{C}, q) with complexified ground ring R_\mathbb{C} = R \otimes \mathbb{Z}[i], accommodating q = |q| \exp(i\theta) (complex chirality rotation). For a hadronic braid \beta_\mathcal{K} \in B_n, the CP-violating discriminant equals the imaginary part of the alternating/symmetric Wedderburn-block trace ratio:

  \delta_{\mathrm{CP}}(\beta_\mathcal{K})
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{Im}\bigl(F_{\mathrm{Pauli}}(\beta_\mathcal{K})\bigr)
  \;=\;
  \mathrm{Im}\!\left(
    \frac{\chi_{(1^n)}(\beta_\mathcal{K})}
         {\chi_{(n)}(\beta_\mathcal{K})}
  \right) \,\in\, R_\mathbb{C}.

The real part supplies the Pauli statistical weight (Pauli factor). The imaginary part isolates CP violation. Amphicheiral or real-q configurations have \mathrm{Im}(\chi_\lambda) = 0 and \delta_{\mathrm{CP}} = 0.

Phase accumulation. For multi-crossing composites, \theta_{\mathrm{res}} accumulates linearly. With \chi_\lambda(q) = \chi_\lambda(|q|) \exp(i\, n_\lambda \theta):

  \mathrm{Im}\!\left(
    \frac{\chi_{(1^n)}(\beta_\mathcal{K})}
         {\chi_{(n)}(\beta_\mathcal{K})}
  \right)
  \;\sim\; \bigl(n_{(1^n)} - n_{(n)}\bigr) \cdot \theta_{\mathrm{res}}

to leading order. The difference n_{(1^n)} - n_{(n)} scales with total crossing number, recovering \delta_{\mathrm{CP}} \sim n_c \theta_{\mathrm{res}}.

Sketch. Spectral completeness over R_\mathbb{C} decomposes F_{\mathrm{Pauli}}. The alternating block V_{(1^n)} provides phase asymmetry, carrying (-q)^{-w} on a writhe-w crossing (antiparticle crossing reversal). The symmetric block carries q^w. Their ratio's imaginary part isolates the CP-violating amplitude.

Falsifiability. Amphicheiral knots must yield exactly \delta_{\mathrm{CP}} = 0. Any amphicheiral hadron exhibiting CP violation falsifies this characterization.

Remark. This relies on (complex chirality rotation). Proof requires demonstrating R_\mathbb{C}-enrichment uniqueness and matching \theta_{\mathrm{res}} to the Wolfenstein parameterization.

Archimedean specialisation. What follows depends on archimedean components: real-valued observables and numerical evaluation at q_0. Categorical identities hold over abstract rings.
heading: Conjecture
